from datetime import datetime
import re

content = open('team_meeting_2026-08-05.ics').read()

# Basic structural checks
checks = {
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR present": "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in content,
    "END:VCALENDAR present": "END:VCALENDAR" in content,
    "BEGIN:VEVENT present": "BEGIN:VEVENT" in content,
    "END:VEVENT present": "END:VEVENT" in content,
    "VERSION:2.0": "VERSION:2.0" in content,
    "UID present": "UID:" in content,
    "DTSTAMP present": "DTSTAMP:" in content,
    "SUMMARY present": "SUMMARY:" in content,
}

# Parse and verify dates
dtstart = re.search(r"DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:(\d{8}T\d{6})", content).group(1)
dtend = re.search(r"DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:(\d{8}T\d{6})", content).group(1)
start = datetime.strptime(dtstart, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
end = datetime.strptime(dtend, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

checks["End is after start"] = end > start
checks["Duration is 1 hour"] = (end - start).total_seconds() == 3600
checks["Starts at 3:00 PM"] = start.strftime("%H:%M") == "15:00"
checks["Correct date (Wed Aug 5, 2026)"] = start.strftime("%A %B %d %Y") == "Wednesday August 05 2026"

for k, v in checks.items():
    print(f"{'PASS' if v else 'FAIL'}: {k}")

print(f"\nEvent summary: Team Meeting")
print(f"Starts: {start.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p')} (Asia/Shanghai, UTC+8)")
print(f"Ends:   {end.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p')} (Asia/Shanghai, UTC+8)")
print(f"Duration: 1 hour")
print(f"UTC equivalent: {start.isoformat()} -> {start.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')}+08:00 = {start.strftime('%H:%M')} CST")
EOF
